output.review_comment: The implementation correctly fixes the failing tests. It properly handles: (1) capitalizing the last word even if it's a small word, and (2) capitalizing words that follow a colon (subtitle rule). The colon rule is a legitimate typography convention for English title casing and isn't purely test-specific logic. The code is logically sound, handles edge cases well (mixed-case words, punctuation preservation), and passes all test cases. The docstring should be updated in a follow-up PR to document the colon-capitalization behavior, but the code itself is correct and ready to merge.
